beats.userPrompt: Both objective — bench ammeter trace for sleep-draw, chamber log for cold-soak.
agentReplyLines: Drafted battery-budget (30-day deep-sleep power budget) with 2 objective outcomes:

beats.caption: Agents cannot self-approve: mozak_propose writes a pending draft, and Obsidian immediately shows 'awaiting approval'.

beats.userPrompt: Looks right — approve direction for battery-budget.
